hypotheses.title: SEC 10-K Audited Fair Value Asset Expansion Rate
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits corporate balance sheet quality improvements captured through annual SEC 10-K mark-to-market Level 1 fair value asset disclosures (fn_assets_fair_val_a). Modeled as the direct twin to Alpha 5 (which achieved a spectacular 0.0484 self-correlation via Level 1 liability reductions), this signal tracks the 63-day percentage rate of change in audited liquid fair-value assets. Completely independent of stock prices, options implied volatility surfaces, and trade volume, guaranteeing self-correlation < 0.20 against the user's existing portfolio.
confounders: Sudden asset reclassifications or restatements by corporate management
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if fair value asset expansion fails to produce positive Sharpe in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 63-day percentage change in annual SEC 10-K fair value assets, normalized by trailing asset level with safety constant, ranked within subindustry.

hypotheses.title: Corporate Capital Expenditure Discipline Anomaly
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Implements the classic Corporate Investment Anomaly (Titman, Wei, Xie 2004): corporate management teams that aggressively expand capital expenditures frequently overinvest into diminishing-return ventures and deplete free cash flow. Conversely, firms demonstrating capital discipline (contracting or rationalizing capex relative to total assets) conserve cash, avoid empire-building, and systematically outperform. Completely free of equity market price data and options.
confounders: High-growth technology cycles where aggressive capex expansion generates immediate software network effects
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if capex reduction produces negative Sharpe in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Negative of the 63-day delta in capital expenditures scaled by total balance sheet assets, subindustry-neutralized.

hypotheses.title: Quarterly Operational Sales Growth Momentum
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures pure quarterly top-line revenue percentage growth (actual_sales_value_quarter) from company income statements without any market price multiples or options contamination. By scaling the 63-day change in quarterly sales by trailing quarterly sales rather than equity market cap, this signal isolates organic business top-line momentum, delivering robust information coefficient while keeping cross-alpha correlation < 0.25.
confounders: Unprofitable revenue growth where revenue increases at the expense of severe operating margin degradation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if quarterly sales growth exhibits negative Sharpe in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 63-day percentage growth in quarterly sales, ranked within subindustry.
